levels.title: Islam
levels.meaning: Submission: the five pillars, the base of the monument

units.title: Shahadah
units.brief: The declaration of faith: there is no god but God, and Muhammad is His messenger. The door into Islam.

units.title: Salah
units.brief: The five daily prayers: a meeting with God at fixed times through the day.

units.title: Zakat
units.brief: A share of what you have, given each year to those in need, which purifies the rest.

units.title: Sawm
units.brief: Fasting from dawn to sunset in Ramadan: learning restraint, and feeling what the hungry feel.

units.title: Hajj
units.brief: The pilgrimage to Makkah, once in a lifetime for those who are able, in the footsteps of Ibrahim.

levels.title: Iman
levels.meaning: Faith: the six beliefs, the middle of the monument

units.title: Allah
units.brief: Belief in the One God, who has no partner, no equal and no likeness.

units.title: Angels
units.brief: Belief in the angels: beings of light who carry out what God commands.

units.title: Books
units.brief: Belief in the books God revealed: the scrolls of Ibrahim, the Torah, the Psalms, the Gospel and the Quran.

units.title: Messengers
units.brief: Belief in the messengers sent to every people, from Adam to Muhammad. Their stories live here.

units.title: Last Day
units.brief: Belief in the Last Day, when every person will stand before God and every deed will be weighed.

units.title: Qadr
units.brief: Belief in God's decree: nothing happens outside His knowledge, and every choice still matters.

levels.title: Ihsan
levels.meaning: Excellence: worshipping God as though you see Him, the peak of the monument

units.title: Ikhlas
units.brief: Sincerity: doing good for God alone, not to be seen or praised.

units.title: Sabr
units.brief: Patience: holding firm through hardship and trusting that it has a purpose. Told through the story of Ayyub.

units.title: Shukr
units.brief: Gratitude: noticing what you have been given, and thanking God with your words and your actions.

units.title: Tawakkul
units.brief: Trust in God: doing your part fully, then leaving the outcome to Him.

units.title: Tawadu'
units.brief: Humility: knowing your worth comes from God, and never looking down on anyone.

units.title: Akhlaq
units.brief: Good character: honesty, gentleness and kindness, the way faith shows in everyday life.
